name: create-cart-envelope-proxied
description: The README/IT 'create' envelope (customerId 001) is POSTed unchanged to shop/ShopService with the inbound SOAPAction; the ShopService envelope containing <cartId> is returned as text/xml with 200.

source.reference: proxying-a-soap-api/src/main/app/soap-api-proxy.xml (cxf:proxy-service/proxy-client payload=envelope, http:request method=POST path=shop/ShopService); proxying-a-soap-api/README.md; proxying-a-soap-api/src/test/resources/message.xml; ProxyingSoapApiIT asserts the reply contains <cartId>
